facts.value: The library holds an Egyptian mummy, Shepenese, dated to the 7th century BC. It reached the library only after the abbey was dissolved.
facts.quote: One item that was not originally in the cabinet of curiosities is the Egyptian mummy Shepenese (7th c. BC).
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://stiftsbezirk.ch/en/stiftsbibliothek/special-collections' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'the Egyptian mummy Shepenese'

facts.value: From the 10th to the 16th century the books were kept in the Hartmut Tower, which came through several fires that raged through the abbey and the town.
facts.quote: tucked safely away in the Hartmut Tower, it defied many threats and several fires that raged through the abbey and the town
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://stiftsbezirk.ch/en/stiftsbibliothek/history' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'it defied many threats and several fires that raged through the abbey and the town'

facts.value: The abbey's oldest library catalogue, Cod. Sang. 728, dates from about 860 to 870 and is still kept in the library.
facts.quote: The oldest library catalogue in St.Gallen, c. 860/870 (St.Gallen, Abbey Library, Cod. Sang. 728, p. 12)
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://stiftsbezirk.ch/en/stiftsbibliothek/manuscripts' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'The oldest library catalogue in St.Gallen, c. 860/870'

events.label: A building is put up in the west wing of the abbey specially for the library.
events.quote: In 1553 a building was constructed especially for the library in the west wing of the abbey
